subject: Request: OpenWave OSS project trial credit top-up / expedited issuance
messages:
From: Sana Malik <sana@openwave.org>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.i@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: OpenWave OSS project trial credit top-up / expedited issuance

Hi Vivek,

Hope you're well — I'm Sana, one of the maintainers for the OpenWave project (open-source realtime audio processing). We're preparing a major release (v2.0) and have a theatrical-scale CI that uses Redwood embeddings and generation for release notes, changelog generation, and automated audio-tagging. Over the last month our usage spiked and our self-serve credits are almost depleted.

Quick background: openwave/core-engine is a MIT-licensed project, ~24 active contributors, used by several small audio startups and academic labs. We onboarded via PLG and currently have the free trial bucket of credits tied to the github org. With the v2.0 release in 10 days we expect another heavy week of builds and regressions — roughly estimated 40–60k tokens/day for 7–10 days.

We're asking Redwood for an expedited top-up of trial credits (or a short trial extension) to ensure CI and release automation don't get blocked. Suggested options:
- Option A: 25,000 trial credits, 3 months
- Option B: 50,000 trial credits, 6 months (preferred)
- Option C: 100,000 trial credits, 12 months (if eligible under community sustainers)

I've attached a short project_summary.pdf and a grant_proposal.md (we include contributor roster and governance info). We're also happy to provide repo permissions/CLA proof or any maintainership verification you need.

Can you advise the typical turnaround for OSS maintainer requests? If there's a faster path (promo team / dedicated credits flow) we'd appreciate being routed. The release date is tight so any expedited help is appreciated.

Thanks — Sana
Sana Malik
Maintainer, OpenWave
https://github.com/openwave/core-engine

---
Attachment: project_summary.pdf (PDF, 320KB)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.com>
To: Sana Malik <sana@openwave.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.i@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-28T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: OpenWave OSS project trial credit top-up / expedited issuance

Hi Sana — thanks for the clear note and the attachments, really helpful.

Quick runbook from our side so we can move fast:
1) Verification: we need the primary repo link (you included), and a short list of core maintainers (names + GitHub handles) — this helps with our OSS program audit.
2) Grant bounds: what is the exact GitHub org/account the trial credits should be applied to?
3) Use-case note: confirm whether these credits are purely CI/test (non-commercial) or if they back a hosted offering.

If you can reply with the maintainer roster and the exact account id we can route to Promotions & Trials (Marissa) for an approval. Given the time sensitivity I'll flag this as expedited.

Marissa / Karthik — looping you in for approvals and to confirm budget coding (promotional vs. committed). If Promotions are OK with Option B (50k / 6mo) we can approve and issue credits to the org centrally; Finance will need deal id OSS-2026-0419 for tracking.

Vivek
Head of Growth (acting)
Redwood Inference

Notes for processing:

- Amount: 50,000 trial credits applied to github.com/openwave

- Promo code / internal ref: OSS-PROMO-2026-OW-50K, deal_id OSS-2026-0419
- How to access: https://console.redwood.com/accounts/openwave/credits (use your org admin login)

Attachment: credits_invoice_stub.pdf (internal stub for tracking)

Couple of operational notes:
- We'll monitor usage for the first two weeks and reach out if usage patterns suggest accidental overconsumption. If you need a temporary higher burst for the release week, reply to this thread and we'll consider a one-time uplift.
- For longer-term support / sustained credits we have a Community Sustainers program; happy to introduce you to the program manager.

Congrats on the v2 release — please ping me if anything blocks the CI.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
